description: File work for later: a bug, a refactor, a follow-up you aren't doing now (it lands in To Do). To file and start work at once, use taskhold_begin. Pass parent_task_id to add one step to an existing task (taskhold_plan for several). Returns the new id, status (todo) and priority. Fails if parent_task_id isn't found or is itself a step (steps don't nest), if project_id doesn't exist (pass project by name instead), or at the account's task ceiling.

parent_task_id.description: Make it a step (subtask) of this top-level task

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Matched case-insensitively; created on first use. Use this instead of project_id.

project_id.description: Project id (project, a name, is easier)

name: taskhold_create
title: Create a task
